turns.replyText:
Do you ship internationally, and who covers customs or duties?

We currently do not ship internationally outside of the United States and select regions in Canada.

Here is how it breaks down:

Where we ship

Contiguous United States: all products
Alaska & Hawaii: select products
Canada: select items to limited regions, seasonally (typically March through August)
All other countries: we do not ship there at this time

Customs, duties, and taxes for Canada
For orders shipping to Canada, all prices are listed in CAD and already include duties and taxes. That means:

You pay the price shown at checkout in CAD.
There should not be an additional customs or duties bill from us on top of that.

If you were hoping to ship to a country other than the US or Canada, I’m sorry we can’t help with that right now. If you are in Canada and want to double-check if your region is eligible, you can start checkout with your address and the site will show you what is available for your area.

turns.replyText:
What's your return and refund policy?

For general returns and refunds, it depends on the item type:

Live plants
We do not accept returns on live plants.
Roses are covered by a 1-year guarantee.
Perennials are covered by a 90-day guarantee.
Bulbs are covered by a failure-to-bloom guarantee.
If a claim is approved, store credit is issued for the current retail value of the plant.
Gardening tools and hard goods
These can be returned within 30 days of delivery if they are new and unused.
Opened or used merchandise is not eligible for return, except gloves, which may be returned if opened and in their original packaging.
Return shipping costs are the customer’s responsibility.
Custom engraved tags and stakes are non-returnable.
Fertilizers, soil amendments, and treatments
These are final sale and are not covered by warranty.
If there’s a concern with one of these items, please reach out right away.

You can read the full policy here: Our Guarantee

turns.replyText:
Do you have a loyalty or rewards program?

We used to have a points-based program called Bud & Blooms, but it was discontinued in the summer of 2023.

During the transition, customers were emailed instructions to convert any qualifying unused points into gift cards (which never expire), and support for that conversion was available through December 31, 2023. As of that date, the program was fully closed and points can no longer be accessed or converted.

Now, instead of a points program, we focus on rewarding customers through promotional and VIP discounts. To hear about these, you can sign up for our email newsletter by scrolling to the bottom of any page on our site and entering your email address.

Thank you for your continued support of Heirloom; we really appreciate you growing with us.
